info.title: Flow API
info.summary: REST API of the Flow issue tracker
info.description:
Flow's HTTP API. Typed operations (with request and response schemas reflected from the server's Go types) form the public contract; every other route is listed as an inventory entry that may change.

Authenticate with a personal API key or an OAuth access token in `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; tokens select their workspace. Browser sessions send the `X-Workspace-Key` header.
Lists return connections (`nodes`, `pageInfo`) paged with `first`/`after` or `last`/`before`, ordered newest first by `orderBy` (createdAt or updatedAt), filtered with a `filter` object.
Errors use one envelope (`error`, `code`, `type`, `requestId`). Requests are rate limited per user or application (X-RateLimit-* headers, HTTP 429 with type RATELIMITED).
The API is unversioned: changes are additive, deprecated operations are flagged and kept for at least six months. See docs/api.md.

X-RateLimit-Complexity-Reset.description: When the complexity bucket is full again (UTC epoch milliseconds).

InvalidInput.description: INVALID_INPUT: the request was malformed or failed validation.

AuthenticationError.description: AUTHENTICATION_ERROR: missing, invalid or expired credentials.

Forbidden.description: FORBIDDEN or FEATURE_NOT_ACCESSIBLE: the caller may not access this resource.

NotFound.description: NOT_FOUND: the resource does not exist or is not visible to the caller.

RateLimited.description: RATELIMITED: a request, complexity or endpoint budget is exhausted.

bearerApiKey.description: Personal API key (flow_api_…) or OAuth access token (flow_oauth_…).

oauth2.description: OAuth 2.0 with PKCE. `actor=app` on the authorize URL installs an application actor; client credentials issue app tokens.
